shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'ls -la && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat index.html && find .. -name AGENTS.md -print'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'workspace div|sidebar|@media|min-width: 1000|personal-section|reader.onload' src/styles.css src/App.tsx | head -45 && sed -n '1,85p' src/styles.css && sed -n '370,435p' src/App.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1248/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome; command -v apt-get; command -v sudo; command -v dpkg-deb; id'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat /etc/os-release && apt-cache policy libglib2.0-0 libglib2.0-0t64 libnss3 && ls /var/lib/apt/lists | head'

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/orbit-browser-deps && cd /tmp/orbit-browser-deps && apt-get download libglib2.0-0 libnss3 libnspr4 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libcups2 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libgbm1 libcairo2 libpango-1.0-0 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libatspi2.0-0 libdrm2 libpixman-1-0 libpangocairo-1.0-0 libharfbuzz0b libthai0 libgraphite2-3 libdatrie1 libfribidi0 libfontconfig1 libfreetype6 libpng16-16 libpcre2-8-0 libmount1 libselinux1 libffi8 libavahi-client3 libavahi-common3 libdrm-common libwayland-server0 libxcb-render0 libxcb-shm0 libxrender1'

/bin/bash -lc 'for package in /tmp/orbit-browser-deps/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$package" /tmp/orbit-browser-libs; done
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/orbit-browser-libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/orbit-browser-libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1248/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome | rg '"'not found'"

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/orbit-browser-deps && apt-get download libxi6 libpangoft2-1.0-0 fonts-dejavu-core fonts-liberation
for package in /tmp/orbit-browser-deps/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$package" /tmp/orbit-browser-libs; done'

/bin/bash -lc "cat > /tmp/orbit-fonts.conf <<'EOF'
<?xml version=\"1.0\"?><"'!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "fonts.dtd"><fontconfig><dir>/tmp/orbit-browser-libs/usr/share/fonts/truetype</dir><cachedir>/tmp/orbit-font-cache</cachedir></fontconfig>
EOF
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/orbit-browser-libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/orbit-browser-libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/orbit-fonts.conf node /tmp/orbit-ui-check.cjs'

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/orbit-browser-deps && apt-get download libsqlite3-0
for package in /tmp/orbit-browser-deps/libsqlite3*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$package" /tmp/orbit-browser-libs; done
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/orbit-browser-libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/orbit-browser-libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/orbit-fonts.conf node /tmp/orbit-ui-check.cjs'
/bin/bash -lc 'npx prettier --write src/App.tsx src/styles.css && npm run build'
